fusions.name: Wing Flash
fusions.desc: Flares a wing in the target's eyes, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Purse
fusions.desc: Flicks a lure at a target at or below 30% health, dealing 20 damage and turning it against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Playing Wounded
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Overdue Windfall
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike has 25% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
